summary: Keep workspace comparison artifacts bounded and outside the analysed repository state

delivery.outcome: compare-workspace writes generated artifacts only below its selected output directory and reads large generated graphs under a comparison-specific bounded ceiling
nonGoals: No scoring or DSL schema change

architecture.rollback: Revert the implementation commit; comparison returns to using ambient config.outputDir

validation.evidence: External output regression leaves no generated directory in the analysed repository

Repository gates pass on exact head
